title: Hauntboard
summary: Public Ootle message board with public threads and encrypted sealed rooms. November 4 inspection loaded the fresh Esmeralda board on runtime 0.49.1 and read the creator’s reset notice: old threads, registries and test balances were removed by the November 2 network reset. New board and room-key registry contracts are now configured; rebuilding the website does not restore old posts. The refreshed recording reads the reset notice and privacy explanation without connecting a wallet or posting. Accepted posts cannot be edited or deleted through Hauntboard; testnet resets may remove history. Titles, fees, spent-output links, timing and network metadata remain public. Room invitations and recovery use separate keys; copied keys and plaintext cannot be revoked, and messages do not authenticate individual authors. The public board may contain unmoderated user content.
cardSummary: Read public Ootle discussions or share encrypted room messages with invitations and separate room-key recovery.
